sources.title: Unstaked APT never withdrawn
sources.summary: You unstaked APT from a Aptos delegation pool. The lockup ended and the APT is withdrawable, but it was never withdrawn.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: unlock completed (stake is inactive, or pending-inactive in a pool whose validator left the set).
howTo: Open the delegation pool in your wallet's staking view and withdraw.
Or call 0x1::delegation_pool::withdraw(pool, amount) from the account that delegated.

run.scope: current_delegator_balances rows with pool_type=inactive_shares and shares>0 (stake_processor)

sanity.check: per pool: sum of delegator inactive stake <= stake::get_stake(pool).inactive

sources.title: APT staked with a validator that stopped
sources.summary: Your APT is still staked in a Aptos delegation pool whose validator left the validator set. It earns nothing and can be unlocked and withdrawn right away.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: the pool's validator is inactive (stake::get_validator_state = 4), so staking stopped; unlock and withdraw are immediate.

protocolStatus.evidence: Aptos framework module 0x1::delegation_pool; per-pool validator state read each run.

howTo: In your wallet's staking view, unlock the stake from this validator, then withdraw it. With the validator out of the set, the withdrawal is available immediately.
Or call 0x1::delegation_pool::unlock(pool, amount), then 0x1::delegation_pool::withdraw(pool, amount).

run.scope: active_shares rows (shares > 0) in delegation pools whose validator state is inactive (4) at enumeration time

sanity.check: per pool: sum of delegator active stake <= stake::get_stake(pool).active

sources.title: Thala APT unstake never claimed
sources.summary: You asked Thala to turn thAPT back into APT. The 14-day wait ended, but the APT was never claimed.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: unstake request matured (end_sec passed).

protocolStatus.evidence: Thala liquid staking PauseFlag false on 2026-10-18.

howTo: Open Thala liquid staking and claim the finished unstake request.
Or call 0xfaf4e633ae9eb31366c9ca24214231760926576c7b625313b3688b5e900731f6::scripts::complete_unstake_APT(request_id) from the requesting account.

run.scope: senders of 0xfaf4e633ae9eb31366c9ca24214231760926576c7b625313b3688b5e900731f6::scripts::request_unstake_APT entry calls (calls made by other contracts excluded)

sanity.check: matured requests found <= TLSD.apt_pending_withdrawal (APT held for claims)

sources.title: Kofi withdrawal never finalized
sources.summary: You asked Kofi to turn kAPT into APT. The ticket unlocked, but the APT was never collected. Kofi is winding down.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: withdrawal ticket unlocked (unlock_timestamp passed); the protocol is also winding down.

protocolStatus.evidence: config::is_winddown became true at version 6,429,705,721 (multisig transaction); deposits and staking paused.

howTo: Open the Kofi app while it is still online and finalize the unlocked withdrawal.
Or call 0x2cc52445acc4c5e5817a0ac475976fbef966fedb6e30e7db792e10619c76181f::gateway::finalize_withdrawals_entry([ticket_id]) from the account that requested it.

run.scope: senders of 0x2cc52445acc4c5e5817a0ac475976fbef966fedb6e30e7db792e10619c76181f::gateway::request_withdrawal_entry, 0x2cc52445acc4c5e5817a0ac475976fbef966fedb6e30e7db792e10619c76181f::gateway::unstake_and_request_withdrawal_entry entry calls (calls made by other contracts excluded)

sanity.check: matured tickets found vs vault::get_unlocked_apt_balance (APT ready for withdrawals)

sources.title: Tortuga unstake ticket never claimed
sources.summary: You unstaked tAPT on Tortuga. The cooldown ended, but the APT ticket was never claimed.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: ticket cooldown passed. Tickets the reserve cannot cover yet are blocked.

protocolStatus.evidence: Contracts still respond; no closure notice verified. Reserve is short of outstanding tickets.

howTo: Open the Tortuga app if it is online and claim the ticket.

Or call 0x8f396e4246b2ba87b51c0739ef5ea4f26515a98375308c31ac2ec1e42142a57f::stake_router::claim(index) from the account that unstaked, where index is the ticket's position in your ticket list (0 = first).

run.scope: senders of 0x8f396e4246b2ba87b51c0739ef5ea4f26515a98375308c31ac2ec1e42142a57f::stake_router::unstake entry calls (calls made by other contracts excluded)

sources.title: Amnis withdrawal never redeemed
sources.summary: You asked Amnis to turn amAPT into APT and received a withdrawal NFT. The lockup ended, but the APT was never redeemed.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: withdrawal token lockup passed (locked_until_secs).
howTo: Open Amnis, go to your withdrawals and redeem the finished withdrawal NFT.
Or call 0x111ae3e5bc816a5e63c2da97d0aa3886519e0cd5e4b046659fa35796bd11542a::router::withdraw_entry(token) from the account holding the "Amnis Withdrawal Tokens" NFT.

run.scope: current owners of tokens in collection 0x40fb9ce6950a90c3677b9c4e1fcd75d2ac2933ae86efdb768955adc6730c6b8d (current_token_ownerships_v2, amount > 0)

sanity.check: matured withdrawal tokens found <= withdrawal::total_pending_withdrawal (all open tokens)

sources.title: Expired veTHL lock never unlocked
sources.summary: You locked THL for veTHL on Thala. The lock period ended, but the THL is still sitting in the lock.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: vote-escrow lock expired (unlockable_epoch reached, as in vetoken::can_unlock<THL>).
howTo: Open Thala, go to veTHL and unlock the expired lock (claim dividends first).

Or call 0x167f411fc5a678fb40d86e0af646fa8f62458b686ad8996215248447037af40c::scripts::unlock<0x07fd500c11216f0fe3095d0c4b8aa4d64a4e2e04f83758462f2b127255643615::thl_coin::THL>() from the locking account.

run.scope: senders of 0x167f411fc5a678fb40d86e0af646fa8f62458b686ad8996215248447037af40c::scripts::lock, 0x3c4a58b4a8dffe6d14448072efcdd5a0e0089a22c6837b94f1d7e8bb1552137f::farming_vesting::convert_to_vethl entry calls (calls made by other contracts excluded)

sanity.detail: no contract total available: balances are stored per account

sources.title: Vested THL never claimed
sources.summary: Thala farm rewards you put into vesting finished vesting, but the THL was never claimed.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: vesting claim reached end_sec with a claimable amount.
howTo: Open Thala, go to vesting and claim the finished vesting.
Or call 0x3c4a58b4a8dffe6d14448072efcdd5a0e0089a22c6837b94f1d7e8bb1552137f::farming_vesting_scripts::claim(claim_id) from the beneficiary account.

run.scope: senders of 0x3c4a58b4a8dffe6d14448072efcdd5a0e0089a22c6837b94f1d7e8bb1552137f::farming_vesting::start_vesting entry calls (calls made by other contracts excluded)

sanity.detail: no contract total available: balances are stored per account

sources.title: TruFin unlock never withdrawn
sources.summary: You unlocked TruAPT on TruFin. The validator lockup ended, but the APT was never withdrawn.
sources.inclusionRule: R2 ended position: unlock request claimable (staker::is_claimable), i.e. its pool lockup cycle ended.
howTo: Open TruFin and withdraw the finished unlock (whitelisted wallets only).
Or call 0x6f8ca77dd0a4c65362f475adb1c26ae921b1d75aa6b70e53d0e340efd7d8bc80::staker::withdraw(nonce) from the requesting account.

run.scope: every entry of 0x6f8ca77dd0a4c65362f475adb1c26ae921b1d75aa6b70e53d0e340efd7d8bc80::staker::Unlocks (one global SmartTable), read at a pinned ledger version

sanity.check: claimable requests found vs staker::Unlocks size (all pending requests)

sources.title: kAPT / stkAPT still held after Kofi's wind-down
sources.summary: Kofi is winding down. kAPT and stkAPT can still be redeemed for APT through a withdrawal ticket. Counted only if no market pays close to redemption value.
sources.inclusionRule: Stranded receipt: protocol wound down and redemption needs an owner action; counted only when no usable market exists (not checked: no quote provider).

protocolStatus.evidence: config::is_winddown became true at version 6,429,705,721 (multisig transaction); deposits and staking paused.

howTo: In the Kofi app, redeem kAPT (or unstake stkAPT) for APT; after the 14-day withdrawal period, finalize the ticket.

Or call 0x2cc52445acc4c5e5817a0ac475976fbef966fedb6e30e7db792e10619c76181f::gateway::request_withdrawal_entry(amount) for kAPT / gateway::unstake_and_request_withdrawal_entry(amount) for stkAPT, then gateway::finalize_withdrawals_entry([ticket_id]).

run.scope: primary stores holding Kofi kAPT or stkAPT (current_fungible_asset_balances, amount > 0)

sanity.check: receipts found in user primary stores <= token supply

sources.title: Merkle Trade LP (MKLP) left after the wind-down
sources.summary: Merkle Trade wound down in February 2026. MKLP can no longer be withdrawn or redeemed; only the Merkle team can enable a release for your wallet.
sources.inclusionRule: Protocol wound down (positions force-closed 2026-02-10); MKLP exits abort E_DEPRECATED on chain.

protocolStatus.evidence: Wind-down announced 2026-02-03 (new positions disabled 02-06, force-closed 02-10, final distribution 02-12); managed_house_lp withdraw and redeem abort E_DEPRECATED (simulated 2026-10-19).

howTo: Contact the Merkle Trade team: old lzUSDC MKLP must be migrated by them first; then they whitelist your wallet for an MKLP release.
Once whitelisted, call 0x5ae6789dd2fec1a9ec9cccfb3acaf12e93d432f0a3a42c92fe1a9d490b7bbc06::managed_house_lp::release_mklp<collateral>() from the holding account.

run.scope: stores holding Merkle MKLP (both collateral types, Coin and paired FA; current_fungible_asset_balances, amount > 0)

sanity.check: MKLP found in holder accounts <= MKLP supply
